tasks.title: Implement deterministic phase→command-spec mapper ngv2/stage_command_map.py
acceptance_criteria: NEW whole-file module ngv2/stage_command_map.py exposes exactly command_for_phase(phase: str, session_ctx: dict) -> dict.
The seven agent-driven phases {hunt, triage, verify, poc, detonate, novelty, report} with valid ctx return {"runnable": True, "phase": phase, "argv": list[str], "output_path": str, "env": dict}.

For an agent phase with valid ctx, argv == ["python", "-m", "ngv2.workers." + phase, "--session-id", session_id, "--repo", repo, "--target", target_path, "--out", output_path] and output_path == f"{output_dir}/{phase}.json".
env == {"NGV2_SESSION_ID": session_id} merged over a COPY of session_ctx.get('env', {}) (or empty dict); the returned env is a distinct object and session_ctx is never mutated.
Non-agent/terminal phases {awaiting_submission, submitted, done} and any unknown phase return {"runnable": False, "phase": phase, "reason": str}.
Missing/empty session_id or output_dir for an otherwise-agent phase returns {"runnable": False, "phase": phase, "reason": str} (fail-closed) with a non-empty reason.
Module is pure/stdlib-only and deterministic: no spawn/fork/exec/subprocess, no filesystem/network/clock/randomness I/O, no eval/exec.
tests/ngv2/test_stage_command_map_wired.py imports command_for_phase from ngv2.stage_command_map and passes GREEN.

spec.objective: Build the NEW whole-file module ngv2/stage_command_map.py exposing the pure, stdlib-only function command_for_phase(phase, session_ctx) that deterministically maps a NobleGreed phase to the COMMAND SPEC used to spawn that phase's agent worker, so no agent decides which driver to launch. It only BUILDS the spec; it never spawns, forks, execs, reads, writes, sleeps, or touches the network/clock/randomness, and never mutates session_ctx.
functional_requirements: Expose exactly one public function command_for_phase(phase: str, session_ctx: dict) -> dict in ngv2/stage_command_map.py.
Recognize the seven agent-driven phases {hunt, triage, verify, poc, detonate, novelty, report} as runnable when ctx is valid.

For a valid agent phase, build argv = ["python", "-m", "ngv2.workers." + phase, "--session-id", session_id, "--repo", repo, "--target", target_path, "--out", output_path] with output_path = f"{output_dir}/{phase}.json".

For a valid agent phase, build env = {"NGV2_SESSION_ID": session_id} merged over a COPY of session_ctx.get('env', {}) (or empty dict), and return {"runnable": True, "phase": phase, "argv": argv, "output_path": output_path, "env": env}.
Return {"runnable": False, "phase": phase, "reason": str} for the non-agent/terminal phases {awaiting_submission, submitted, done} and for any unknown phase.
Fail-closed: return {"runnable": False, "phase": phase, "reason": str} with a non-empty reason when session_id or output_dir is missing or empty for an otherwise-agent phase.
Never mutate the input session_ctx: env must be built on a copy so the returned env is a distinct object and a deep-equality of session_ctx holds before and after the call.
spec.interfaces: command_for_phase(phase: str, session_ctx: dict) -> dict. session_ctx carries session_id (str), repo (str), target_path (str), output_dir (str), optional model (str), optional env (dict). Returns runnable spec {runnable: True, phase, argv, output_path, env} for valid agent phases; fail-closed {runnable: False, phase, reason} otherwise. Pure/deterministic, no subprocess/I/O.
edge_cases: (a) phase="poc" with full ctx -> runnable is True; output_path endswith "poc.json"; argv contains "--session-id" and the literal session_id value; argv contains "-m" and "ngv2.workers.poc".
(b) phase="awaiting_submission" -> runnable is False (human/terminal phase, no agent) with a reason.
(c) unknown phase="foo" -> runnable is False with a reason.
(d) ctx missing session_id (e.g. {"repo":..., "target_path":..., "output_dir":...}) -> runnable is False with a non-empty reason.
(e) input session_ctx is NOT mutated by the call: deep-equality before/after holds, and the returned env is a distinct object containing NGV2_SESSION_ID.
Empty-string session_id or empty-string output_dir for an agent phase -> fail-closed runnable is False.
Agent phase with no 'env' key in session_ctx -> env defaults to {"NGV2_SESSION_ID": session_id} only; session_ctx still not mutated.
Terminal phases 'submitted' and 'done' -> runnable is False with a reason.
non_goals: Does NOT spawn, fork, exec, or subprocess anything; only builds the spec.
Does NOT perform any filesystem, network, clock, or randomness I/O, and contains no eval/exec.
Does NOT mutate the input session_ctx (env is built on a copy).
Does NOT author new tests (the oracle tests/ngv2/test_stage_command_map_wired.py is pre-committed).
Does NOT touch any harness/**, config/**, scripts/**, services/**, or _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE file.
No integration / end-to-end conductor spawn-loop test is in scope for this pure single-file validation leaf.
spec.implementation_notes:
Define a module-level frozenset/tuple of the seven agent phases {hunt, triage, verify, poc, detonate, novelty, report} and treat everything else (including the terminal/non-agent {awaiting_submission, submitted, done} and unknown phases) as not-runnable. Order the checks fail-closed: if phase not in agent set -> {runnable: False, phase, reason}; else read session_id, repo, target_path, output_dir from session_ctx and if session_id or output_dir is missing/empty -> {runnable: False, phase, reason}; else compute output_path = f"{output_dir}/{phase}.json", build the fixed argv list, build env = {**dict(session_ctx.get('env') or {}), 'NGV2_SESSION_ID': session_id} (a fresh dict so session_ctx is untouched and NGV2_SESSION_ID wins), and return the runnable spec. Use only the standard library; no imports that perform I/O. The reachability/wiring is provided by the pre-committed oracle which imports command_for_phase from the live ngv2.stage_command_map; do not author or modify tests.

# CREDENTIAL-NAMING CONSTRAINT (the AST security gate FAILS the build if a variable whose name contains (case-insensitive) "password", "secret", or "key" is assigned a string literal -- it reads as a hardcoded credential even though this is an external clean-room target with no real secret). NEVER bind a string literal to such a variable. Use a neutral name instead (field_name, check_id, label, name, ident, column) or iterate a collection literal / build the mapping from a list of tuples. This applies to dict keys held in a temp var, field labels, and constant identifiers.

# STDLIB-ONLY CONSTRAINT (the verification environment installs NO third-party packages, so importing one fails collection -> the whole build is rolled back and the leaf is parked). Import ONLY the Python standard library. Import NO third-party package: NO pydantic, NO pydantic_settings, NO attrs, NO pyyaml, NO numpy, NO requests, etc. For data models / config use stdlib dataclasses (dataclasses.dataclass), enum.Enum, typing, and plain dict / json instead of pydantic BaseModel / BaseSettings. If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

# DETERMINISM CONSTRAINT (the AST nondeterminism gate FAILS the build if it sees a wall-clock or nondeterministic source). Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.


# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/ngv2/test_stage_command_map_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle for ngv2.stage_command_map -- the deterministic phase->command-spec
mapper that NobleGreed's bug-hunt state machine uses to decide which agent-worker
driver to spawn for a given phase. It is PURE and stdlib-only: it BUILDS a command
spec; it NEVER spawns, forks, execs, subprocesses, reads/writes disk, touches the
network, the clock, or randomness.

command_for_phase(phase, session_ctx) returns, for an agent-driven phase
{hunt, triage, verify, poc, detonate, novelty, report} with a valid ctx:
  {"runnable": True, "phase": phase, "argv": list[str], "output_path": str, "env": dict}
and for a non-agent/terminal phase {awaiting_submission, submitted, done}, an
unknown phase, or a ctx missing session_id/output_dir:
  {"runnable": False, "phase": phase, "reason": str}.
The input session_ctx is NEVER mutated (env is built on a copy).

This oracle is the *_wired reachability proof: importing command_for_phase from the
live ngv2.stage_command_map module is the wiring contract (the conductor spawn path
calls exactly this to decide which driver to launch per phase).
"""
import copy

from ngv2.stage_command_map import command_for_phase

AGENT_PHASES = ["hunt", "triage", "verify", "poc", "detonate", "novelty", "report"]
TERMINAL_PHASES = ["awaiting_submission", "submitted", "done"]


def _full_ctx():
    return {
        "session_id": "sess-abc123",
        "repo": "owner/target-repo",
        "target_path": "/work/target-repo",
        "output_dir": "/work/out",
        "model": "opus",
    }


# --- wiring / contract: callable importable from the live module ------------
def test_wired_command_for_phase_is_importable_and_callable():
    res = command_for_phase("poc", _full_ctx())
    assert isinstance(res, dict)
    assert "runnable" in res
    assert res["phase"] == "poc"


# --- (a) agent phase "poc" with full ctx -> runnable spec -------------------
def test_poc_full_ctx_is_runnable_spec():
    ctx = _full_ctx()
    res = command_for_phase("poc", ctx)
    assert res["runnable"] is True
    assert res["phase"] == "poc"
    assert isinstance(res["argv"], list)
    assert all(isinstance(a, str) for a in res["argv"])
    assert res["output_path"].endswith("poc.json")
    assert res["output_path"] == "/work/out/poc.json"
    # argv carries the session-id flag AND the literal session_id value
    assert "--session-id" in res["argv"]
    assert "sess-abc123" in res["argv"]
    # argv launches the per-phase worker module
    assert "-m" in res["argv"]
    assert "ngv2.workers.poc" in res["argv"]
    # env carries the session id, on its own dict
    assert isinstance(res["env"], dict)
    assert res["env"]["NGV2_SESSION_ID"] == "sess-abc123"


def test_all_agent_phases_runnable_and_output_path_matches_phase():
    for phase in AGENT_PHASES:
        res = command_for_phase(phase, _full_ctx())
        assert res["runnable"] is True, phase
        assert res["phase"] == phase
        assert res["output_path"] == f"/work/out/{phase}.json"
        assert f"ngv2.workers.{phase}" in res["argv"]


# --- (b) terminal/non-agent phase -> not runnable ---------------------------
def test_awaiting_submission_is_not_runnable():
    res = command_for_phase("awaiting_submission", _full_ctx())
    assert res["runnable"] is False
    assert res["phase"] == "awaiting_submission"
    assert isinstance(res.get("reason"), str) and res["reason"]


def test_all_terminal_phases_are_not_runnable():
    for phase in TERMINAL_PHASES:
        res = command_for_phase(phase, _full_ctx())
        assert res["runnable"] is False, phase
        assert isinstance(res.get("reason"), str) and res["reason"]


# --- (c) unknown phase -> not runnable --------------------------------------
def test_unknown_phase_foo_is_not_runnable():
    res = command_for_phase("foo", _full_ctx())
    assert res["runnable"] is False
    assert res["phase"] == "foo"
    assert isinstance(res.get("reason"), str) and res["reason"]


# --- (d) missing session_id -> not runnable, with reason --------------------
def test_missing_session_id_is_not_runnable_with_reason():
    ctx = {
        "repo": "owner/target-repo",
        "target_path": "/work/target-repo",
        "output_dir": "/work/out",
    }
    res = command_for_phase("poc", ctx)
    assert res["runnable"] is False
    assert res["phase"] == "poc"
    assert isinstance(res.get("reason"), str) and res["reason"]


def test_missing_output_dir_is_not_runnable_with_reason():
    ctx = {
        "session_id": "sess-abc123",
        "repo": "owner/target-repo",
        "target_path": "/work/target-repo",
    }
    res = command_for_phase("poc", ctx)
    assert res["runnable"] is False
    assert isinstance(res.get("reason"), str) and res["reason"]


# --- (e) input session_ctx is NOT mutated -----------------------------------
def test_session_ctx_not_mutated():
    ctx = _full_ctx()
    ctx["env"] = {"PRE_EXISTING": "keep"}
    before = copy.deepcopy(ctx)
    res = command_for_phase("hunt", ctx)
    assert ctx == before, "command_for_phase must not mutate session_ctx"
    # env was built on a copy: distinct object, carries the session id,
    # and preserves the caller's pre-existing env entries.
    assert res["env"] is not ctx["env"]
    assert res["env"]["NGV2_SESSION_ID"] == "sess-abc123"
    assert res["env"]["PRE_EXISTING"] == "keep"


# --- determinism ------------------------------------------------------------
def test_output_is_deterministic():
    a = command_for_phase("verify", _full_ctx())
    b = command_for_phase("verify", _full_ctx())
    assert a == b

```

test_spec.test_data_requirements: A full valid session_ctx fixture {session_id, repo, target_path, output_dir, optional env}; a ctx variant missing session_id; a ctx variant with empty output_dir; the canonical phase vocabulary source→hunt→triage→verify→poc→detonate→novelty→report→awaiting_submission→submitted→done; an unknown phase string "foo". All assertions are exercised by the pre-committed tests/ngv2/test_stage_command_map_wired.py oracle.
